root.name: French Defense: Reversed Philidor Formation
root.moves: 1. e4 e6 2. d3 d5 3. Nd2 Nf6 4. Ngf3 Nc6 5. Be2

overview: White plays a King's Indian Attack-style set-up with d3, Nd2, Ngf3, Be2 and O-O against the French, and Black plays ...d5, ...Nf6, ...Nc6. Neither side commits early and the game revolves around White's e5 advance versus Black's ...e5 or ...Be7.

white_ideas.idea: Castle, play Re1 and e5, then g3 or a kingside attack

typical_structures.structure: Closed centre with e4-d3 vs e6-d5

approach.notes: A set-up White can use against many defences.

character.reason: The set-up is compact and neither side takes early risks.
